--alias.help: the model name the API reports (default: the name stored in the model file)

--allowed-host.help: also answer to this Host name (repeatable; "*" turns the check off)

--answer-room.help: reserve space for closing the thinking and the answer when the output cap is at least 1024 tokens; an explicit request budget of 0 opts out

--api-key.help: require this key on /v1/* (Authorization: Bearer ... or x-api-key); command line only, not allowed in a --config file

--config.help: a JSON file {"server": {...}, "engine": {...}, "models": [{"model": FILE, ...}]}: settings named without the dashes. "server" holds what the server shares, "engine" what applies to every model that ta

--cors-origin.help: let web pages from this origin use /v1/* (repeatable)

--debug.help: log one line per request and the raw model text after each reply

--fit-max-tokens.help: clamp max_tokens to the remaining context instead of rejecting the request with 400

--frequency-penalty.help: default frequency_penalty for requests that leave it out: penalty growing with how often a token was seen

--gpu.help: the GPUs to use, as nvidia-smi numbers them: exactly these, the first is the main card and the engine gives the rest their roles ("0,1"); auto = every Blackwell card, the fastest as main (default: GPU

--grammar.help: hold every tool call and JSON response format to a grammar in the engine (on by default; a request with strict: true gets it either way); --no-grammar turns it off

--host.help: the address to listen on: 127.0.0.1 = this PC only (the default), 0.0.0.0 = also other devices on your network (give --api-key)

--idle-sleep.help: put the model to sleep after this many seconds without requests: its VRAM is freed, its RAM copy, conversations and learned expert placement stay, and the next request wakes it in a few seconds (Linux

--idle-unload.help: unload the model after this many seconds without requests; the next request loads it again

--image-dir.help: let requests from other machines name image files under this directory (repeatable). Requests from this machine need no flag

--image-remote-only.help: treat requests from this machine as remote too, so they get only data: URLs and what --image-url-host and --image-dir allow. For a server behind anything on this machine that forwards other people's r

--image-url-host.help: let requests from other machines name http(s) image URLs on exactly this host (repeatable; without a port, 80 and 443). A name must resolve to public addresses; an IP address is taken as written. Requ

--lazy.help: start the API unloaded; load on first request; a sidecar image encoder is dropped, --vision dynamic stays

--max-payload-mib.help: the largest request body the server reads, in MiB; a bigger one gets a 413 (default 256)

--min-free-vram-mib.help: load an unloaded model only when this much VRAM is free, else answer 503

--min-p.help: default min_p for requests that leave it out: drop tokens less likely than this times the likeliest, 0..1 (0 = off)

--mock-engine.help: run a scripted engine instead of the model, for clients and tests (no --model needed)

--model.help: the .basalt model file: the engine, tokenizer, sampling and vision come from it

--open.help: open the local page in the browser once the model is ready

--penalty-last-n.help: default penalty_last_n for requests that leave it out: the window the penalties look back over, in tokens (at most 4096)

--port.help: the TCP port to listen on (default 8080)

--presence-penalty.help: default presence_penalty for requests that leave it out: flat penalty on a token seen in the window

--reasoning-budget-tokens.help: default thinking budget for requests that leave reasoning_budget_tokens out (0 = none): at the budget the thinking is closed and the answer starts, so set it below the request's max_tokens

--repetition-penalty.help: default repetition_penalty for requests that leave it out: multiplicative penalty on seen tokens, > 0 (1 = off)

--request-lines.help: echo the engine's per-request summary on stdout, for a supervisor that only sees this output

--script.help: the mock engine's answer (default: a short greeting); given more than once, requests get them in turn and the last one repeats

--seed.help: default seed for requests that leave it out: fix the random draw, an integer

--slot-full-context.help: with --parallel, give every slot the whole --max-context instead of an equal part: N slots cost N times the KV cache

--temperature.help: default temperature for requests that leave it out: 0 = greedy; higher is more random

--thinking-loop-tokens.help: end the thinking and let the model answer when it repeats one token this many times in a row inside the thinking (0 = never)

--tokenizer.help: tokenizer directory for the mock engine (a byte tokenizer if absent)

--top-k.help: default top_k for requests that leave it out: keep the K likeliest tokens (0 = off: every token)

--top-p.help: default top_p for requests that leave it out: nucleus cutoff, 0 < value <= 1 (1 = off)

--vision.help: image input: off (default), dynamic (inside the engine: it borrows expert-cache slots on the main GPU while it reads an image, no standing VRAM), cpu (no VRAM, slow) or a GPU number, as nvidia-smi num
